<title level="1" right="Action">[Arrest a Fall](/Actions.aspx?ID=2308) <actions string="Reaction" /></title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 418

**Trigger** You fall.

**Requirements** You have a fly Speed.

</column>

---

You attempt your choice of an [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) check or Reflex save to slow your fall. The DC is typically 15, but it might be higher due to air turbulence or other circumstances.

**Success** You take no damage from the fall.
name: Arrest a Fall
